test_title: PYST 25: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 30 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Substitute one word for the italicised expression.

As a port it was notorious for its *__smuggling and the trade was prohibited by law__*.
solution:
The correct answer is: **illicit**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the context of the sentence, **"smuggling and the trade was prohibited by law"** refers to activities that are illegal or not allowed by law.
 
• Therefore, the appropriate one-word substitute that captures the essence of being forbidden or illegal is **"illicit."**
